literal_meaning: পিঠের দিকে হাত মোড়া করে বাঁধা
figurative_meaning_bn: দড়ি দিয়ে উভয় হাত পিছনে নিয়ে শক্ত করে বাঁধা
figurative_meaning_en: To tie both hands behind the back tightly with a rope, restraining someone securely
similar_in_english: Tie someone's hands behind their back
example_sentences_in_bangla: অপরাধীকে পিঠমোড়া করিয়া আটক করা হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The police tied the thief with his hands behind his back.
The criminal was restrained by binding his hands behind him.
note: This idiom reflects traditional methods of securing prisoners in Bengali society.
